kind: Edited recording of actual Second Look browser interactions
content: Live normal-app Qwen review, buyer acknowledgement, actual sandbox order creation, explicit capture and persisted completed receipt. Fictitious PayPal approval occurred between takes and is explained in captions.

sourceFootage.timing: real protocol timestamps sampled at 24 fps; static periods hold captured pixels; no interpolated motion

trim.reason: Retain the actual capture and completed receipt; exclude the final reload interval whose immediate UI assertion ran during loading.

cuts.description: The actual returned quote suggestions and unchanged full listing were read and checked between takes before saving the delegated sandbox test decision.

PayPal approval was completed with the already signed-in fictitious buyer between takes. The provider account screen is excluded. The next take verifies APPROVED with no capture, then requests capture explicitly.
The first take's final immediate reload assertion ran during loading. Its unverified interval is trimmed; the final separate take shows a fresh reload and verifies the same completed receipt.

captions.pixelComparisonScope: Every composed1280x720 UI crop is byte-identical to its decoded input RGB before lossy JPEG/VP8 encoding; captions occupy only appended rows720..851.
captions.encodingBridge: Pillow quality100, subsampling0 JPEG image2pipe; installed FFmpeg cannot decode PNG input

visualInspection.method: All 83 retained source frames reviewed in contact sheets with critical receipt frames inspected at full size; full original video decoded successfully. All eight final caption cue midpoints and final frame decoded and visually inspected.

limitations: Four recorded takes with explicit cuts; this is not one uninterrupted end-to-end recording.
Provider account/sign-in/approval screen is excluded; separate buyer approval was performed on PayPal sandbox and provider approval checked before capture.
A failed final immediate reload assertion was trimmed from one actual capture take, with original failed metadata retained; a separate final take verifies reload persistence.
These interactive examples are not a new model-quality evaluation or proof of general retrieval/payment reliability.
